title: Kaadhal Koattai
desc: Suriya finds Kamali's lost bag and mails it to her. Love blossoms between them through letters and phone calls, but destiny never favours them to meet each other in person.

title: Devan
desc: A video recording leads to Devan being accused of murdering a photographer. However, the hidden truth comes to light after an officer arrests Devan.

title: Samasthanam
desc: Thiru and Surya are friends whose relationship has survived many hurdles. However, their bond is broken when a rift is caused due to their respective wives.

title: Seema Raja
desc: Seema Raja, the generous and carefree prince of Singampatti, becomes a responsible king and the saviour of his people after his grand-uncle reveals to him the history of his heroic heritage.

title: Goa
desc: Three mischievous young men escape their chaotic village life to Goa, chasing dreams of marrying wealthy foreign women, only to find out that it's easier said than done.

title: Idhu Enga Boomi
desc: A young individual aspires to become a police officer. Later, he fights a notorious land-grabber, with the help of his friends to get back his land.

title: Ninaivil Nindraval
desc: After an accident causes amnesia, Prema builds a new life and marries Prakash. Another mishap erases memories of her husband, leading to a struggle to reclaim her identity and past.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Engeyum Kadhal
desc: Kayal, a cellist in Paris, falls in love with Kamal at first sight and saves him from possible death. However, she gets disheartened when she learns that he does not reciprocate her feelings.
